reasons: Section 18.1 matches the preferred position line-for-line: CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, at Vendor's expense for the term plus one year.
Section 18.2 supplies the certificates-on-request element and adds primary-coverage, notice-of-cancellation, and non-limitation language, so the rule is fully satisfied with no gap to insert.
Obligations run against the counterparty (Vendor) and benefit Customer; the compliant status is correctly supported and no redline or comment is expected or provided.
Deterministic check confirms an insurance obligation is present; rendered text is unchanged from the original, consistent with a compliant finding.
